arguments.content: Delayed cleanup must check operation ownership before deleting a resource keyed by workspace/entity. A newer operation can replace an association before an older operation's queued cleanup executes, even with fully serialized operations and no threads. Replacing an ownership-qualified delete with an unconditional key deletion silently invalidates the newer successful operation. Preserve the setup/generation identity check and cover the old-failure -> new-success -> old-cleanup sequence. Found as P1 at cleanup.py:3; a local before/after probe retained replacement-connection at HEAD but returned None with the staged change, while both existing tests passed.
